fetch_status: All 11 fetches succeeded on first attempt; no WebSearch fallback needed. /sitemap.xml was an index pointing to /sitemap-0.xml, which yielded the complete KB article enumeration (~200 articles across 25 sections: get-started, concepts, events, sessions, speakers, contacts, evaluations, communications, portals, participants, sponsors-exhibitors, speaker-crm, settings, reporting, event-team, marketing, studio, awards, agents, site, documents, integrations, apps, faq, videos). Deep-fetched 8 flow articles covering event setup, form builder, evaluation plans, agenda, accept/decline, email sending, speaker assignment, portals.
summary: SessionBoard is a speaker and content management platform covering the full organizer journey: create event (name, slug, timezone, dates, logo, record settings) -> build a 4-section customizable session submission form (welcome, session info, speaker info, form settings) with custom fields and conditional logic -> collect submissions with 5-stage status pipeline (Pending, Accepted queue, Accepted, Decline queue, Declined) -> grade via evaluation plans (anonymized review, 1-5 or 1-20 rating scales, weighted rubrics, evaluator assignment, round-based) -> build agenda with 5 views (List/Day/Week/Month/Rooms), drag-and-drop scheduling by track color, and automatic conflict detection (overlaps and double-booked participants) -> communicate via templated email/SMS with per-recipient preview (100/send cap, no auto-email on status change) -> onboard accepted speakers through configurable portals (tasks, file requests, forms, wiki pages, appearance theming, field-level visibility). Adjacent modules: contacts/CRM (org-level pipeline, segments), sponsors/exhibitors with intake forms, reporting dashboards with custom views and exports, event team roles, data import, embeds/program site, plus AI features (AI evaluations, AI agenda builder, Insights AI) and a marketing/studio suite.

user_journeys.name: Launch a call for papers
steps: Create event; in Settings fill event name, slug, type, website URL, location, timezone, start/end datetimes, theme description
Upload logo (300x300) and background image (1500x500)
Configure record settings: submission limit per user, auto portal access, additional contacts, primary speaker, record ID prefix
Open Sessions > Forms; edit default submission form
Customize Welcome screen message; add session fields (Add Field: standard/custom, event- or global-level); add speaker fields (First/Last/Email locked)
Add layout elements via blue + icon: section header, divider, rich text; apply conditional logic on checkbox/dropdown/number fields
Set form settings: close date, 5/1-day reminder emails, admin notification, speaker limit (max 15), submission limit, confirmation message with 10s portal redirect
Share public form link (View Form)
user_journeys.filled_state: Settings page shows a complete event profile (e.g. ACME Conference 2025, app URL slug acme-conference-2025, GMT-5 timezone, Dec 2-5 2025); form builder shows 4 sections with ~10 mixed-type questions; public form renders welcome screen then paginated session and speaker questions.

user_journeys.name: Review and accept submissions
steps: Sessions > Evaluation > Evaluation Plans > Add Plan; enter name and instructions with scoring guidance
Toggle anonymized review (hide speaker names), weekly Monday reminders, session-file access
Pick grading: faces/numbers 1-5 or stars/hearts 1-20; optional weighted rubric summing to 100%; max evaluations per submission
Filter which sessions enter the plan; configure which session/speaker fields evaluators see; add custom rating questions (dropdown, comment)
Add evaluators to event, then assign to (closed) plan; open plan
Evaluators score sessions; organizer monitors Evaluation Summary and exports reports
In Sessions module, click status pill and move sessions between Pending / Accepted queue / Accepted / Decline queue / Declined, incl. bulk updates
Select accepted/declined records and separately send decision emails (status change never auto-emails)
user_journeys.filled_state: Evaluation plan detail shows N assigned evaluators and per-session average scores; Sessions table shows a mix of status pills across ~30 submissions with dashboard columns showing form answers.

user_journeys.name: Build and de-conflict the agenda
steps: Sessions > Settings: define rooms and tracks (tracks drive session colors)
Open Sessions > Agenda; switch among List, Day, Week, Month, Rooms views
Drag accepted sessions onto date/time slots and rooms (only Accepted status appears by default; configurable)
Zoom Rooms view (rooms on x-axis) to spot gaps
Open Sessions > Agenda > Conflicts; review overlapping sessions and double-booked participants; sessions with conflicts show a red dot
Reschedule to clear conflicts; refresh to re-run detection
user_journeys.filled_state: Day view shows a color-coded grid of sessions across 4-6 rooms and 3 days; Conflicts tab lists 1-2 remaining issues; List view table shows every accepted session with date, time, room, track.

user_journeys.name: Onboard accepted speakers via portal
steps: Open Portals; use Default People portal or create a custom portal filtered by role/session type
Create tasks: general task with deadline, file request (e.g. upload headshot), form (e.g. bio confirmation); add resources: static files and wiki pages
Configure visibility: Always Show Tasks toggle, field-level view/edit/hide, reminder frequency, deadline extension (final deadline defaults +7 days)
Customize appearance: welcome message, accent color, logo, background image
Invite users to the portal; grant portal access to event contacts
Speaker logs in, sees Invited Sessions / My Submissions / Confirmed Participation sections, completes tasks
Organizer tracks task completion and sends reminder emails
user_journeys.filled_state: Portal admin view lists 3 tasks with completion counts (e.g. 12/20 headshots uploaded); speaker-side portal shows branded welcome screen, task checklist with due dates, and confirmed sessions.

features.name: Event details settings
features.description: Settings module captures event name, URL slug, event type, website URL, location, timezone, start/end date-times, theme description, logo (300x300) and background image (1500x500). AI features consume type/URL/location/theme.
features.ui_expectations: Settings page/form with labeled fields, timezone dropdown, date-time range picker, two image upload slots with dimension hints, save persists.

features.name: Record settings
features.description: Event-level toggles: submission limit per user, automatic portal access on contact creation, additional-contacts collection, primary speaker designation, participant (speaker) acceptance workflow, headshot file restrictions, sponsor/exhibitor logo limits, record ID prefixes (3-6 uppercase chars).
features.ui_expectations: Toggle/number-input list within Settings; prefix text inputs with validation.

features.name: Submission form builder
features.description: Sessions > Forms hosts a default editable CFP form with 4 sections: Welcome screen, Session Information (required page heading, custom questions), Speaker Information (First/Last/Email locked), Form Settings. Add Field picker offers standard + custom fields; new fields can be event-level or global; editing a field affects all forms using it.
features.ui_expectations: Form list with ellipsis menu (Edit/View Submissions/View Draft Submissions/View Form/Duplicate/Delete); section-tabbed editor; Add Field modal; field Actions ellipsis for label/help-text edits.

features.name: Conditional logic and layout elements
features.description: Question rules (conditional logic) on Checkbox, Dropdown, and Number fields show/hide dependent questions. Blue + icon inserts section headers (255-char max), dividers, and rich text blocks (images, links, formatting) between fields.
features.ui_expectations: Rule builder on eligible fields; insertion + icon between rows; rich text editor.

features.name: Form settings and publishing
features.description: Per-form: close date (blocks new submissions/edits), automatic reminder emails 5 and 1 day before close, admin notification on new submission, speaker limit up to 15 per session, submission limit per submitter, custom confirmation message, automatic 10-second redirect to portal. Public shareable form URL; submitters can save drafts.
features.ui_expectations: Form Settings panel; public form reachable without login via link; closed form shows closed state.

features.name: Submission status pipeline
features.description: Five statuses: Pending (default), Accepted queue, Accepted, Decline queue, Declined; custom statuses creatable in Program settings. Status changed via dropdown on the status pill; bulk status updates supported. Status change deliberately does NOT auto-email submitters.
features.ui_expectations: Status pill per row in Sessions table; dropdown on click; multi-select checkboxes enabling bulk status action.

features.name: Sessions dashboard and manual session management
features.description: Sessions table with customizable dashboard views that can surface submission-form answers as columns; pencil icon opens session editor; manual session creation; clone session; subsessions (create, convert session<->subsession, view in agenda); draft submissions view; per-session file upload/download enablement; embeds for public display.
features.ui_expectations: Data table with column/view customization, row edit icon, Create Session button, drafts filter.

features.name: Evaluation plans (session grading)
features.description: Sessions > Evaluation > Evaluation Plans > Add Plan. Config: name, instructions, open/closed state, anonymized review (hides speaker names), weekly Monday evaluator reminders, session-file access toggle, session filters, evaluator-visible field selection, custom rating questions (dropdown, comment box). Grading (immutable post-create): faces/numbers 1-5 or stars/hearts 1-20, optional weighted rubric summing to 100%, max evaluations cap per submission. Roles: Evaluator, Evaluator Session Manager, Admin. Evaluators must be added to event first; plan must be closed to assign. Results admin-only; export per-plan or cumulative reports; duplicate plans.
features.ui_expectations: Plan list with ellipsis actions; multi-step plan wizard; evaluator assignment picker; summary view with per-session scores.

features.name: Round-based and AI evaluations
features.description: Multi-round evaluation workflow advances submissions through successive review rounds (setup documented in dedicated article). AI Evaluations auto-score submissions (AI-assisted grading; details inferred from norms - AI produces suggested ratings organizers can review).
features.ui_expectations: Round selector/progression controls on evaluation plans; AI evaluation trigger and generated scores.

features.name: Agenda builder with 5 views
features.description: Sessions > Agenda offers List (default table), Day (hourly timeline), Week (7-day), Month, and Rooms (rooms on x-axis, zoomable) views. Drag-and-drop accepted sessions to assign date, time, and room. Track assignment determines session color in Day/Week/Rooms views. Only Accepted sessions appear by default; additional statuses configurable. Rooms/tracks managed under Sessions > Settings.
features.ui_expectations: View switcher; calendar grid with draggable session cards; color-coded by track; room columns.

features.name: Agenda conflict detection
features.description: Sessions > Agenda > Conflicts detects overlapping sessions and double-booked participants (same speaker in concurrent sessions). Conflicted sessions show a red dot in agenda views; conflict list updates on page refresh.
features.ui_expectations: Conflicts tab/panel listing issues; red-dot badge on conflicting session cards.

features.name: Email composer (bulk send)
features.description: From Contacts/Sessions/Sponsors/Exhibitors modules: check records > Send Emails. Popup: recipient scope incl. additional contacts, replies-to (single address), send-from, CC/BCC (up to 5 each), subject, rich body, Template button for prebuilt templates, per-recipient preview by clicking each contact, Send Now. Hard cap 100 recipients per send; no attachments (share files via portal); default sender no-reply@notify.sessionboard.com unless custom-domain add-on.
features.ui_expectations: Row checkboxes; Send Emails action; two-pane compose modal (settings left, body right); recipient preview list.

features.name: Templates, automation, SMS, history
features.description: Email templates and themes (Settings), automated emails (form reminders, portal task reminders, weekly digests), SMS messaging, email/SMS history log with per-message tracking, notifications, custom email domain add-on.
features.ui_expectations: Template library CRUD; history table with status per recipient; SMS compose.

features.name: Contact creation and speaker assignment
features.description: Contacts module > Add Contact (first name, last name, email required). Contacts appear in Speakers module only once assigned to a session: edit session > Participants tab > Session Participants dropdown (event contacts only) > Save. Speakers drag-reorder for display order; visibility toggle (public by default, appears in embeds; hidden = is_public FALSE via API). Also: moderators/chairpersons, additional contacts, merge duplicates, contact profile with New/Returning badge.
features.ui_expectations: Add Contact modal; Participants tab with searchable dropdown; Speakers module listing assigned speakers with reorder handles and eye/visibility icon.

features.name: Speaker acceptance workflow
features.description: Optional participant-acceptance flow: invited speakers confirm participation via portal; portal splits sessions into Invited Sessions (awaiting response), My Submissions, Confirmed Participation sections (renameable, up to 100 chars; confirmed section can merge into My Submissions).
features.ui_expectations: Accept/decline controls on invited sessions in speaker portal; organizer-side acceptance status tracking.

features.name: Portal configuration
features.description: Three default portals (People, Exhibitor, Sponsor) plus custom portals filtered by role/session type/tier. Config: tasks (general with deadline, file request, form), resources (static files, wiki pages), Always Show Tasks toggle (off = only accepted speakers see tasks), field-level visibility (view-only/editable/hidden) for contact and session data, reminder frequency, deadline extension with Final Deadline (default +7 days), weekly digest, appearance (welcome message, accent color, logo, background image), user invitations, admin view-as-portal-user, task completion tracking, mark-complete on behalf of users.
features.ui_expectations: Portals module with per-portal settings pages: Tasks, Appearance, Visibility tabs; invite users action; task completion dashboard.

features.name: Sponsors and exhibitors
features.description: Group-based records for sponsors and exhibitors with member contacts, sponsor/exhibitor intake forms, sponsor settings (tiers inferred), logo limits, dedicated group portals.
features.ui_expectations: Sponsors and Exhibitors modules with group cards/tables and intake form links.

features.name: Organization-level speaker CRM
features.description: Cross-event contact database: custom CRM fields, advanced search, segments, pipeline (kanban-style speaker sourcing, inferred), interest forms, add contact to events, invite organization team members.
features.ui_expectations: Org-level CRM area separate from event; segment builder; pipeline board.

features.name: Reporting, dashboard views, export
features.description: Customizable dashboard views (choose columns incl. custom fields, save views), custom reports, data export (CSV/XLSX), Insights AI analytics.
features.ui_expectations: View/column picker on module tables; Export button producing file download; reports area.

features.name: Event team and access
features.description: Invite and manage event team members with roles (admin vs evaluator have different access), new-user login flow, password reset, 2FA, unlock locked users, evaluator access limited to assigned plans.
features.ui_expectations: Team settings page with invite-by-email, role dropdown, member list.

features.name: Data import and bulk edit
features.description: CSV/XLSX import for contacts/sessions with mapping (common import issues documented), bulk edit fields, add existing contacts to new events, clone entire event, archive events.
features.ui_expectations: Import wizard with file upload and column mapping; bulk edit action on selections.

features.name: Public publishing: embeds and program site
features.description: Embeddable public agenda/speaker widgets for external sites; hosted program site; print agendas; document generation. Hidden speakers/sessions excluded from public embeds.
features.ui_expectations: Embed code generation; public agenda/speaker directory rendering accepted content.

features.name: AI and marketing add-ons (surface map)
features.description: Adjacent modules enumerated in KB: Studio AI agenda builder, AI content remix, Agents, Marketing suite (clips, recaps, posts, quotes, dispatch, advocacy, media library, brand kits, live transcribe, ready room, attendee view), Awards module (submission forms, paid entries, payment gateways, reviewer rounds), integrations (Cvent, Swapcard, Bizzabo, Stova, Swoogo, ON24, Grip, ExpoPlatform, Zapier, webhooks, API tokens, SSO).
features.ui_expectations: Out of scope for core organizer rubric; presence of any is bonus.

rubric.criterion: Organizer can configure core event details (name, slug/URL, timezone, start/end dates, location, logo upload) in a settings area and changes persist
auto_steps: Log in as organizer; navigate to event Settings
Verify presence of fields: event name, slug/URL, timezone selector, start/end date-time, location, logo upload
Change event name to 'ACME Conference 2025 v2' and timezone; save
Reload page; confirm both values persisted
rubric.pass_criteria: All listed fields exist and edited values survive a page reload
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of settings form before and after reload showing persisted edits

rubric.criterion: Submission form builder exposes editable sections (welcome + session questions + speaker questions) and supports adding a custom field that renders on the public form
auto_steps: Navigate to Sessions/Forms area; open the submission form editor
Verify welcome/session/speaker sections exist and speaker First/Last/Email fields are present
Add a new custom dropdown field 'Track preference' with 3 options to the session section; save
Open the public form URL (logged out or incognito); confirm the new dropdown renders with its options
rubric.pass_criteria: Custom field created in builder appears on the live public form
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of builder with new field + screenshot of public form showing it

rubric.criterion: Form close date is enforced: a form with a past close date rejects new submissions
auto_steps: In form settings, set close date to yesterday; save
Open public form URL
Confirm form shows closed/unavailable state or blocks submission
Reset close date to future; confirm form accepts input again
rubric.pass_criteria: Past close date blocks submission; future close date restores it
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of closed-state public form and reopened form

rubric.criterion: Status pipeline works: session status changes via dropdown among at least Pending/Accepted/Declined (queue states are bonus), and bulk status update on multiple selected sessions works
auto_steps: Open Sessions list with seeded submissions
Click status control on one Pending session; select Accepted; verify pill updates
Select 2+ sessions via checkboxes; apply bulk status change to Declined
Reload; verify all statuses persisted
rubric.pass_criteria: Single and bulk status changes apply and persist; no automatic email is required
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of status dropdown, bulk action, and updated table after reload

rubric.criterion: Organizer can manually create a session and edit an existing one from the sessions table
auto_steps: Click Create/Add Session; fill title and required fields; save
Verify new session row appears in table
Open edit (pencil/row action) on that session; change title; save; verify update in table
rubric.pass_criteria: Session created and edited without going through public form
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of table showing created then renamed session

rubric.criterion: Evaluation plan can be created with name, instructions, anonymized-review toggle, a rating scale selection, and at least one custom rating question, and an evaluator can be assigned
auto_steps: Navigate to Evaluations/Evaluation Plans; click Add Plan
Fill name + instructions; toggle anonymize speaker names; select a rating scale (e.g. 1-5)
Add a custom comment-box rating question
Filter/select sessions into the plan; assign an evaluator user; save
Verify plan appears in plan list with assigned evaluator count
rubric.pass_criteria: Plan persists with all settings; UNVERIFIED by agent: the evaluator's actual scoring experience and anonymization effect require logging in as the evaluator account
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of each wizard step and the saved plan detail

rubric.criterion: Evaluation results are visible to admins: a summary view shows per-session scores/averages and evaluation progress
auto_steps: With seeded evaluations present (or after scoring as a second evaluator account if the harness supports it), open the evaluation summary/results view
Verify per-session aggregate score and count of completed evaluations displayed
Verify results are not exposed to speaker-facing surfaces
rubric.pass_criteria: Summary displays aggregates; UNVERIFIED: correctness of averaging math unless fixture scores are known; export file contents need manual check
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of summary table with scores

rubric.criterion: Agenda offers a list view plus at least one calendar-style view (day/week/rooms), and dragging an accepted session onto a time slot/room assigns and persists date/time/room
auto_steps: Accept at least 3 sessions; open Agenda
Switch between list view and a day/rooms calendar view
Drag an unscheduled accepted session to a specific time slot and room
Reload; verify the session retains its date/time/room in both views
rubric.pass_criteria: View switching works; drag-drop assignment persists across reload
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of both views and the scheduled session after reload

rubric.criterion: Conflict detection flags overlapping sessions in the same room and/or a speaker double-booked across concurrent sessions
auto_steps: Schedule two accepted sessions in the same room at overlapping times (or same speaker in two concurrent sessions)
Open the Conflicts view/tab (refresh page)
Verify both sessions are listed as conflicting and/or show a conflict indicator (e.g. red dot) in the agenda
Move one session to a free slot; refresh; verify conflict clears
rubric.pass_criteria: Conflict appears when overlap is created and clears when resolved
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of conflict list/indicator, then cleared state

rubric.criterion: Organizer can select contacts/sessions and compose a bulk email with subject, body, reply-to, and recipient preview, then send
auto_steps: In Contacts (or Sessions), check 2+ records; click Send Emails
Verify compose UI shows recipient list, reply-to, send-from, subject, body editor
Fill subject/body; if templates exist, load one; preview rendering for an individual recipient
Click Send; verify UI confirms send and message appears in email history/log
rubric.pass_criteria: Compose-and-send flow completes with in-app confirmation/history entry; UNVERIFIED: actual email delivery — human must check a controlled inbox for receipt and merge-field rendering
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of compose modal, per-recipient preview, and history log entry

rubric.criterion: Contact-to-speaker flow: create a contact (first/last/email), assign them to a session via a participants control, and see them appear in the Speakers area
auto_steps: In Contacts, click Add Contact; enter first name, last name, email; save
Verify contact appears in Contacts but NOT yet in Speakers list (if clone models this distinction)
Edit a session; in Participants section, search and add the contact as speaker; save
Verify contact now appears in Speakers module linked to that session
rubric.pass_criteria: Assignment via session participants makes the contact a speaker; core pass = contact creation + assignment + speaker listing
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of contact creation, participants tab, and Speakers list

rubric.criterion: Portal configuration: organizer can create/edit a portal, add a task (deadline task, file request, or form), and customize appearance (welcome message, color or logo)
auto_steps: Open Portals module; verify default portal(s) exist; open portal settings
Create a task 'Upload headshot' as a file request with a due date; save
Set a welcome message and accent color/logo in appearance settings; save
If an admin 'view as portal user' / preview exists, open it and verify the task and branding render
rubric.pass_criteria: Task and appearance settings persist; full pass if admin preview shows them; UNVERIFIED without preview: real portal-user experience needs a second (speaker) account login
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of portal settings, task list, and portal preview

rubric.criterion: Organizer can track portal task completion status per contact (e.g. completed vs outstanding counts or per-user checkmarks)
auto_steps: With a portal task assigned to seeded contacts, open the task tracking/completion view
Verify per-contact or aggregate completion status is displayed
If supported, mark a task complete on behalf of a user; verify status updates
rubric.pass_criteria: Completion state visible to organizer; UNVERIFIED: end-to-end completion by an actual portal user requires second account

rubric.criterion: Dashboard views are customizable: organizer can change visible columns on the sessions table (including a submission-form/custom field) and the view persists or is savable
auto_steps: Open Sessions table; open column/view customization control
Add a custom form question as a column and remove another column
Verify table re-renders with the new columns and data populates
Reload or reopen saved view; verify configuration retained
rubric.pass_criteria: Column set is editable, shows custom-field data, and persists
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of column picker and resulting table

rubric.criterion: Data export: exporting sessions or contacts produces a correct CSV/XLSX file containing the visible records and fields
rubric.pass_criteria: Human clicks Export on the sessions or contacts table, downloads the file, opens it, and confirms row count matches the table and columns include custom fields; file is valid CSV/XLSX
rubric.evidence: The downloaded file plus a screenshot of the source table for row-count comparison

rubric.criterion: Event team management: organizer can invite a team member by email with a role (admin vs evaluator) and the pending invite/member appears in the team list
auto_steps: Open event team/settings area
Invite a new user by email selecting a role
Verify the invitee appears in the team list with pending/invited state and correct role
rubric.pass_criteria: Invite recorded with role; UNVERIFIED: invite email receipt and the invitee's scoped access (evaluators limited to assigned plans) require a second inbox/account — human should complete signup and confirm an evaluator cannot see admin settings
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of team list showing pending invite with role

sample_data: Event: "ACME Conference 2025" (slug acme-conference-2025, type Conference, San Francisco CA, timezone America/New_York, Dec 2-5 2025 8:00am-5:00pm, theme "Developer tools and AI infrastructure", 300x300 logo, 1500x500 banner). Rooms: Main Hall, Room 101, Room 102, Workshop A. Tracks: AI/ML (blue), DevOps (green), Leadership (orange), Security (red). Submission form fields: session title, abstract (textarea), format dropdown (Keynote/Talk/Panel/Workshop), track preference dropdown, AV needs checkbox with conditional follow-up text field, speaker first/last/email, bio, headshot upload, company, job title. 30 seeded submissions: 18 Pending, 4 Accepted queue, 5 Accepted, 1 Decline queue, 2 Declined; 2 draft submissions. Contacts: 25 speakers (3 unassigned), 2 moderators, 1 chairperson; 1 duplicate pair for merge testing. Evaluation plan "Round 1 Content Review": 1-5 numeric scale, anonymized, weighted rubric (Relevance 40/Originality 30/Speaker experience 30), 3 evaluators (eval1@example.test etc.), seeded scores on 10 sessions. Agenda: 4 accepted sessions pre-scheduled with one deliberate conflict (two sessions in Room 101 at Dec 3 10:00am; one speaker double-booked). Portal tasks: "Upload headshot" (file request, due Nov 1), "Confirm bio" (form), "Register for event" (general task); 12/20 completed. Email template "Acceptance Notification" with merge fields for first name and session title.
gaps: Docs not fetched in depth (article titles known, contents not read): round-based evaluation advancement mechanics, AI evaluations, session-settings detail (exact room/track creation steps - room editing confirmed in Session Settings, track creation inferred), program settings custom statuses UI, embeds/program-site publishing flow, automated email triggers list, SMS specifics, importing-data wizard detail, CRM pipeline, marketing/studio/awards modules, all FAQ articles. Public agenda publishing mechanism is not detailed in the agenda article (embeds/program site are the documented outlets - inferred). Onboarding checklist is an external Google Sheet, not an in-app feature, so it is excluded from the rubric. Inferences marked "(inferred)" in features: pipeline as kanban board, sponsor tiers, AI evaluation behavior. Rating-scale specifics (faces/numbers 1-5, stars/hearts 1-20, immutable after creation) and the 100-recipient email cap are SessionBoard-specific quirks; rubric treats reasonable equivalents in a clone as passing since the kit is implementation-agnostic. Evaluator-side scoring UX, portal participant UX, and email deliverability are only judgeable with second accounts/inboxes - flagged in rubric as auto-partial/manual.
